name: Photo Studio
description: Take beautiful screenshots: a free camera, freeze the whole scene, pose anyone, portrait and square photos, looks and lights, hide yourself or any effects — and ReShade.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Photo Studio panel next to a frozen boss fight — the free camera orbits anyone you pick.
A posed group photo taken with Photo Studio.
Portrait photos are drawn in the tall shape at full detail, not cropped.

added: Head and Eyes Free aim: drag the dot on a grid to point exactly where you want, or nudge it with the arrows.
A Step switch (Fine, Normal, Coarse) sets how far each arrow press moves the aim, and it is remembered.
The current aim shows under the arrows, for example x +0.30, y -0.10.
changed: The free camera's hint bar now tells you that Z and C tilt the camera, and Roll is now called Tilt.
Dragging the aim grid or a colour picker no longer scrolls the Photo Studio window (needs framework 2.18.0).

dependencies.name: ReShade (add-on build)
dependencies.notice: ReShade's add-on build is meant for single-player games or games without anti-cheat. Blue Protocol has no anti-cheat today; use it at your own discretion.

dependencies.name: Microsoft shader compiler (for Proton / Linux)
dependencies.description: Lets ReShade compile every effect when the game runs under Proton. Windows already has it.
